note: Six private rapid cave turns per diagnostic, 144 FPS cap, same 2560x1440 output and 1334x750 ray input. Metrics are exposure-normalized differences from each shot's own settled image, not ground-truth error or artifact counts. No diagnostic here replaces the installed 48-candidate/history-8 profile.

runs.label: installed-reference
runs.status: Current installed profile; six of the twelve previously published turns.

runs.label: no-temporal-history
runs.status: Temporal carry disabled, spatial reuse retained. Worse noise; rejected.

runs.label: spatial-stratification
runs.status: Randomly shifted Hammersley disk donors. No material gain; rejected.

runs.label: one-bounce
runs.status: One bounce removes indirect lighting and darkens the scene. Diagnostic only; rejected as a quality profile.

runs.label: 128-initial-candidates
runs.status: Four bounces retained; 128 light candidates. Little convergence gain for much more initial-generation work; rejected.

runs.label: continuation-guide
runs.status: Classify the actual resampled continuation for denoiser guide data. Cave result essentially unchanged. Archived candidate; material/other-denoiser review still required before general adoption.

runs.label: two-indirect-samples
runs.status: Two independent rough opaque continuations averaged, with the guide correction. Small image gain, much higher GPU cost. First-path guide/split signals are a diagnostic limitation. Rejected; not suitable for shipping.

gpu_cost_diagnostic.scope: Final three 300-frame GPU timestamp windows at the settled cave camera, 144 FPS cap; not uncapped throughput.
